nodes.speaker: Technician
nodes.text: Careful with the cables! This is the nerve center of the whole village.

nodes.speaker: Technician
text: Server Stats gives you a live view of the Raspberry Pi running this entire platform. CPU, memory, temperature, disk — all real-time.
Network traffic, PM2 processes, even top system processes. It's like an X-ray of the machine keeping this village alive.

nodes.speaker: Technician
nodes.text: The portal to Server Stats is on the right. Owner access only — don't want just anyone poking around the server internals.

nodes.speaker: Technician
nodes.text: Look at the monitors — each one tracks a different metric. The green text? That's real data. Portal's on the right.

nodes.speaker: Technician
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Keep the servers cool!
